**Clarify comment: records are no longer Running at this point.**

The code comment says "For Running records where the agent exited" but the condition checks for `Done | Failed | NeedsReview` statuses. Consider updating the comment to:
```rust
// For records that transitioned this run (agent exited and checker updated status),
```

**Unbounded duplicate dispatches on every health run** `collect_auto_review_candidates` collects ALL `NeedsReview` records with a PR URL regardless of whether they are newly-transitioned in this health run (`r.changed`).
